ListSandboxesV2.limit: Number of items per page, default 100; values less than 1, greater than 100, or non-numeric are treated as 100.
ListSandboxesV2.nextToken: Pagination cursor; use the X-Next-Token value from the previous page's response header. Omit for the first page.
ListSandboxesV2.metadata: Metadata filter, formatted as URL-encoded key=value&key2=value2; multiple conditions are combined with AND.
ListSandboxesV2.state: State filter; options are running and paused. Can be passed repeatedly (state=running&state=paused) or comma-separated (state=running,paused); defaults to both running and paused when omitted.
